english.pointstoprove:
date and location
Conspired with others to intentionally without consent
penetrate the anus / vagina / mouth of a woman aged 16 or over
with your penis not reasonably believing that she had consented

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Officers should carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Provisions under sections 224 to 235 of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 may mean that s/he is liable to receive a longer sentence if certain conditions apply.
(ii) A prior conviction for an offence listed in Schedule 15 to the Sentencing Act 2020, may render the convicted person liable to a mandatory life sentence in relation to a second offence listed under that Schedule, as per Section 273 (offender aged 18 or over but under 21 when convicted of the second offence or Section 283 (offender aged 21 or over).
